items.sentence: [MASK], for improper conduct, violation of the zero-tolerance policy, and violation of the joint statement on violence and behavior in the workplace.

On [MASK], after a meeting with mail handlers about mistaken labels on containers held by Complainant’s first-line supervisor (Supervisor) and second-line supervisor (Manager), Complainant called Manager “sorry” and/or “a sorry ass.” Report of Investigation (ROI) at 19- 24, 78, 85, 89-90.
[MASK] stated that he instead said, “This is bullshit,” on the way to the conference room with Supervisor.
Complainant attended a Pre-Disciplinary Interview on [MASK], with his union representative, Supervisor, and another supervisor (Supervisor 2) to discuss what happened on August 19, 2015.
At that meeting, [MASK] explained that the Agency would be recommending his removal.
